reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 13 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 79 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 195 and 244 total points.

analyst.text: Cade Cunningham was a late scratch on Tuesday with right-knee soreness, and J.B. Bickerstaff would only say he is 'battling through a lot'; he is day-to-day for Friday. Detroit showed they can cope, beating Orlando 104-86 without him behind 21 from Isaiah Joe. Milwaukee only just ended a 13-game losing streak. Even if Cunningham sits again, the spot leans Detroit.
